phrase.zh: 看不见的结构，也在塑造感受。
phrase.en: Unseen structures shape what we sense.

visual.zh: 深色珠与细杆组成透视椭圆闭环，前低后高，中央放小型琥珀液玻璃瓶；紫褐背景与暖纸前景区分空间。
visual.en: A closed perspective ellipse of dark beads and rods rises behind a small amber-liquid glass bottle. Plum background and pale foreground separate the space.

background.zh:
鲁齐卡因多亚甲基化合物和高等萜类研究共同获得1939年诺贝尔化学奖。他对麝香类香气物质的大碳环结构的研究，拓展了当时对有机环状化合物的认识。画面把细杆连接的深色珠环放大香水瓶周围，表达气味背后的结构。珠数、大小和连接只是原创示意，不是某种物质的准确分子模型，也不能概括他的全部研究。短句为原创。
1939年化学奖；获得本年度奖项的一半。获奖理由（中文译述）：研究多亚甲基化合物和高等萜类
background.en:
Ruzicka shared the 1939 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for work on polymethylenes and higher terpenes. His study of large carbon rings in musk-related scent compounds broadened understanding of organic ring compounds. An enlarged loop of dark beads joined by slender rods surrounds a small perfume bottle, expressing structure behind scent. The bead count, scale and connections are an original illustration rather than an exact molecular model or a summary of all his research. The phrase is original.
1939 — The Nobel Prize in Chemistry. Received half of the prize. Official motivation: for his work on polymethylenes and higher terpenes
